chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Parents and grandparents
summary: Grandparents on both sides were partly Indian.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you describe anything about your father and mother?
Jay C. mentioned something about your grandmother coming from North Dakota, something like that. Do you remember anything about her?
No, my grandmother, I know she was half Indian on my father's side.
My mother's mother died when she was 6 years old but I do remember Pa-Pa.
He was a nice old gentleman. He was part Indian too.
Did you see your other grandpa?
So you didn't get to see him?
No, only my grandmother on my father's side.
